text:
elaine: Hey team, terraform plan in CI for staging is hanging on remote refresh, seen it for ~6 mins now. Anyone else? :eyes:
sanjay: I saw the same on my run a few mins ago. `terraform init` completed but `refresh` is stuck on provider plugin call.
chris: Got a snippet of the CI log?
elaine: Pasted —
elaine: ```
2025-11-03T14:12:23Z [INFO] provider.aws: Refreshing state...
2025-11-03T14:12:29Z [ERROR] provider.aws: error making API request: expired token
2025-11-03T14:12:29Z [INFO] waiting for remote state lock release...
```
matt: expired token = usually creds rotated in Vault or IAM session expired. Who rotated creds recently?
sanjay: We rotated the CI vault token yesterday evening, but Jenkins secrets plugin should pick up new one. Maybe the runner cached an old session.
chris: @deploy-bot can you show the workspace lock state?
deploy-bot: workspace "staging-networking" is locked by run 2025-11-03_14:10 (agent-7). Lock held for 12m.
elaine: Ok lock explains apply stall. But we need to fix refresh failing with expired token first; otherwise plan will error repeatedly.
matt: Quick mitigation: can we force-unlock the workspace, re-run with fresh creds, and re-init? That should unblock other runs.
sanjay: I can force-unlock but want to avoid corrupting state if that run is still mid-write. Any sign it progressed to apply?
chris: From the logs it didn't reach apply; only refresh failed. Safe to force-unlock.
sanjay: Doing `terraform force-unlock -force 12345-abcdef` on the remote workspace now.
sanjay: Done. Lock cleared. :white_check_mark:
elaine: Thanks. I'll kick a local run to reproduce quickly before CI.
elaine: Re-ran locally, got `provider: error: token invalid`; pulled new Vault token and exported `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` — re-init and refresh succeed. Plan now proceeds.
matt: Great — can we add a CI step that re-reads Vault at job start and fails early if token invalid? Right now it proceeds and only fails during refresh which leaves locks.
chris: Good call. Also add short retry on provider auth error with clearer error message to avoid force-unlock guesswork.
sanjay: I'll open a tiny PR to the Jenkins job: ensure Vault plugin lookup right before `terraform init`, and add `TF_WORKSPACE` lock timeout to 5m with safe retry.
elaine: Sounds good. Also adding a small note in the runbook: steps for expired token -> force-unlock -> re-run with fresh creds. I'll update ops-runbook.md accordingly.
matt: For follow-up, can we detect expired-token in the logs and auto-unlock after confirming no apply in progress? low-risk automation.
chris: Let's discuss automation in backlog grooming. For now PR + runbook is enough. Thanks all. :rocket:
